claims.text: Animate the supplied photo with slow drifting motion, preserving the requested i2va target and first-frame anchor.
The image is a vertical multi-panel character reference sheet on a dark background with a top hero panel, three turnaround views, and four detail crops.
The hero panel shows a full-body figure standing on a wet nighttime urban walkway with metal railings, rain streaks, reflective pavement, and blurred warm and cool city lights.
The figure wears a black high-collared tactical jacket with strap and buckle details, a dark crew-neck shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
The figure has short dark hair with shaved sides and a small tied section at the back, plus a visible scar through one eyebrow.
Subtle rain drift, shimmering reflected city lights, and a faint breeze stirring the figure's hair and jacket edges are permitted creative motion additions within the held hero panel.

description.text: remains the locked anchor: a vertical multi-panel character reference sheet presented within the requested 16:9 frame. The top hero panel shows a lean adult figure standing on a wet nighttime urban walkway, framed by metal railings that recede on both sides. Rain streaks hang in the air, the pavement holds broken reflections, and blurred city lights glow in warm amber and cool blue-gray behind the figure. The figure wears a black high-collared tactical jacket with strap and buckle details, a dark crew-neck shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots. Short dark hair is shaved at the sides, with a small tied section at the back, and a scar cuts through one eyebrow. Beneath the hero panel, the turnaround row and the four detail crops remain in their dark charcoal studio layout, with soft low-key directional lighting and restrained contrast. The palette stays desaturated black, charcoal, cool blue-gray, and warm amber, with photorealistic dark cinematic character-concept styling. Within this held sheet, the hero panel alone gains restrained life: rain drifts downward in fine streaks, reflected city lights shimmer in the wet ground, and the figure's hair and jacket edges stir under a faint breeze while the surrounding reference views stay still.
